scripts.all:del: bun presta:del && (cd selenium && bun sel:down) && (rm -rf scrapper-results)
scripts.all:setup: bun all:deps && (bun db:restore || true) && bun db:down && echo 'Setup complete. You can now `bun presta:up` to start the PrestaShop environment.'
scripts.all:deps: bun presta:deps && (cd scrapper && bun deps) && (cd selenium && bun deps)
scripts.presta:deps: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml pull && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml build
scripts.presta:up: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build
scripts.presta:down: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.presta:del: bun presta:down -v && sudo rm -rf prestashop/src && git restore prestashop
scripts.db:up: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d db
